title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE AN ORDER ATTACHING THE NATIONAL YOUTH COMMISSION FROM THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT TO THE DEPARTMENT OF SOCIAL WELFARE AND DEVELOPMENT

text.en:
The National Youth Commission is hereby attached to the Department of
Social Welfare and Development.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 7th day of MAY
Thousand and Nine.
in the year of Our Lord, Two
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
